name: Visitor starts an enquiry and messages persist for the administrator
description: Verifies a visitor message is stored and can be read and answered by the allowlisted administrator.
steps: Open Enquiries and send a message
Sign in to the admin inbox as helloprephub@gmail.com
Open the new conversation and reply
expected: The visitor message appears in the admin inbox and the admin reply appears in the visitor chat.

name: Visitor and administrator exchange an image attachment
description: Verifies both sides can attach an image and see the uploaded image in the conversation.
steps: Open an enquiry on mobile and attach a JPG image
Send the image with a short message
Sign in as the administrator and open the conversation
expected: Both image attachments render in the correct conversation and the chat remains usable on mobile.

name: Unauthorised account cannot access private enquiries
description: Verifies the admin inbox rejects a signed-in account that is not the configured administrator.
steps: Sign in with a different email account
expected: The account is denied and no customer enquiry list or messages are disclosed.

name: Visitor can resume an enquiry after refreshing the page
description: Verifies a visitor's enquiry thread is retained across a browser refresh.
steps: Start an enquiry and send a message
expected: The same conversation and its previous message are displayed after refresh.
